name: buddy
description: Your terminal pet, back for good, now living in a Soundtrack pane beside the chat: what Spotify is playing with a live equaliser the pet dances to, playback and volume controls, your playlists, vibe-generated playlists, notes stamped with the track, a coffee, tea and water tracker, the session's telemetry and your plan usage. The pet still hatches, levels up, gets hungry, naps, judges your prompts and keeps its diary.
